terminals.name: data-plane
terminals.description: Embedded Postgres (:5432) + system Redis (:6379); applies migrations and idempotent seed on start.

terminals.name: auth
terminals.description: Auth service on :4001 (sessions, JWT, CSRF, admin APIs).

terminals.name: wallet
terminals.description: Wallet service on :3002 (wallet lifecycle, balances, ledger).

terminals.name: gateway
terminals.description: API gateway on :4000; reverse-proxies auth/wallet. Swagger at /api/docs.

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Next.js user web app on :3000 (calls the gateway).
